solution_steps: Use Monster Reincarnation and discard Rare Metal Dragon to return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to your hand.
Tribute summon Blue-eyes by tributing Kaiser Glider and Breaker the Magical Warrior
Revive Rare Metal Dragon and Kaiser Glider using Premature Burial and Monster Reborn.
Attack Big Koala with Kaiser Glider. Then use Kaisers effect to return Master of Oz to the Extra deck.
Attack Jinzo with Rare Metal Dragon.
Finally, let Reflect Bounder attack directly.
